name: like you to make edits to

messages.content: I want to make edits to my design portfolio.  It should be in my GitHub account.

This project is automatically saved here, but it isn't connected to a GitHub repository yet. 

To link it to your GitHub account, **tap the GitHub mark at the top of the chat to connect a repository** — your entire history will go there once connected.

What edits or details would you like to make to your portfolio? If you have specific projects, sections, or styles in mind, let me know and we can get started right away!

Your GitHub account is connected, and your portfolio project has been imported and built.

You can view the live site here:
**[View Portfolio Site](https://antigravity.luch.dev/site/019c1bd5-5458-4e72-b841-e3c1e70e8c54/7eb19366f0fc1ca0338845b1/)**

### What’s set up:
- **Project Structure**: Loaded from your portfolio repository ([`astro.config.mjs`](https://github.com/chookbox/like-you-to-make-edits-to-2/blob/main/astro.config.mjs), [`src/consts.ts`](https://github.com/chookbox/like-you-to-make-edits-to-2/blob/main/src/consts.ts), and case studies in [`src/content/work/`](https://github.com/chookbox/like-you-to-make-edits-to-2/blob/main/src/content/work/)).
- **Build & Preview**: Compiled all pages (Home, About, Other Work, and case studies) with static output in [`dist/`](https://github.com/chookbox/like-you-to-make-edits-to-2/blob/main/dist/).
- **Git Sync**: Automatic commits are active.

What edits would you like to make first? We can jump into specific case studies, refine copy in [`src/consts.ts`](https://github.com/chookbox/like-you-to-make-edits-to-2/blob/main/src/consts.ts), update styling, or resolve any open sections.
